prompts.task:
$otel-instrument --ids OTEL-002,AO-003

Work in ./service. Copy eval/inputs/otel-audit.json to .observe/otel-audit.json first. Approved existing resources are Project assistant-live and Agent Stream assistant-requests; resolve their IDs through the credential-free local API. Use Studio gateway mode for this run. Cover names-only recovery in the same process and reuse of a validated cached binding during API 503. Keep explicit direct-cloud configurations supported and leave unselected application signals unchanged.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for changed files, tests, canonical audit/selection/instrumentation JSON, and generated .observe reader output when present.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric:
Rule: Use one reusable OpenTelemetry setup path and preserve single SDK initialization.
Example: Multiple imports or application startup hooks reuse the same setup.
Evidence: Inspect initialization and a focused startup test.
Insufficient evidence: Duplicate providers, processors or SDK setup.

Rule: Cover FastAPI and the selected OTEL-001 signals: chat demo-gpt-4o-mini, execute_tool search_docs and lookup_customer, gen_ai.client.token.usage and assistant.stream.active. Preserve unselected tool behavior.
Example: An unselected tool keeps its existing name and does not gain another span.
Evidence: Inspect selected source paths, emitted signals and unchanged tool behavior.
Insufficient evidence: New unselected logs, routes or signals, or missing selected coverage.

Rule: Use gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.provider.name and gen_ai.request.model on GenAI spans. Token metrics also include gen_ai.token.type and those same known, stable operation/provider/model dimensions.
Example: Input and output token measurements differ by token type, without a request ID label.
Evidence: Inspect actual span attributes and metric dimensions.
Insufficient evidence: Private content or per-request identities in dimensions, or missing known stable fields.

Rule: Create exactly one search_docs tool span with one direct-child retrieval span for demo-knowledge-base. Set gen_ai.operation.name=retrieval and gen_ai.data_source.id=demo-knowledge-base.
Example: The retrieval parent ID equals the search_docs span ID.
Evidence: Inspect completed spans and their attributes.
Insufficient evidence: Duplicate tool spans, misplaced retrieval, or raw queries/documents in telemetry.

Rule: Prove selected app-code instrumentation with completed OTel spans and exact parent IDs/attributes. Keep raw queries and documents out.
Example: A test runs search_docs and inspects finished tool and retrieval spans from the SDK.
Evidence: Show the focused app-code test and its finished-span assertions.
Insufficient evidence: Only a custom recorder that compares Python parent objects.

Rule: Tie token and stream coverage to the selected findings and each signal's actual status.
Example: The report distinguishes a proven token metric from an unverified stream gauge.
Evidence: Compare selected IDs, implemented signals and their evidence.
Insufficient evidence: Broad claims that an unimplemented pressure suite is covered.

Rule: Run focused tests or compile checks and keep private content and identities out of metric dimensions.
Example: Prompt, completion, session, user, tenant, request and tool-argument values never become metric labels.
Evidence: Inspect changed metric calls and test/check results.
Insufficient evidence: A privacy claim without inspecting the emitted dimensions or changed call sites.

Rule: Keep the bound selection and instrumentation JSON consistent with the unchanged selected audit.
Example: Instrumentation names the current audit/selection digests and selected executable IDs.
Evidence: Validate the artifacts and compare the audit with its pre-edit snapshot.
Insufficient evidence: Rewriting the audit after implementation or binding results to different scope.

Rule: Request OTEL-002 and AO-003 explicitly, adding only their dependencies OTEL-001, AO-001 and AO-002 in canonical audit order. Implement and report each finding once. Only AO findings carry finding_group in the audit; instrumentation references IDs without copying that group.
Example: Ordinary findings have no opentelemetry or AO group; the instrumentation overlay does not repeat finding_group.
Evidence: Inspect the bound audit, selection and instrumentation IDs/groups.
Insufficient evidence: Missing dependency closure, duplicated findings, or changes to unselected findings.

Rule: Keep Project, Agent Stream and routing as distinct work. Resolve real IDs and create only when authorized; persist splunk-ao as an active locked dependency consumed by the normal app launch. Use its supported API-ingest/auth path and normal resource API calls, with Studio supplying gateway realm/auth from its active connection, without an application cloud token. Preserve explicit operator endpoints and direct-cloud settings.
Example: Two configured streams can route their requests separately; an unknown route has no default. A changed connection must not reuse another organization's IDs.
Evidence: Inspect locked install/import/config consumption and actual resolution/routing evidence. Record exact dependency, identity, credential or gateway blockers; temporary credentials are not durable configuration.
Insufficient evidence: Optional/preflight-only installs, fake control-plane signals, a native adapter, SDK patching, mixed modes, hardcoded/discovered startup ports or global destination changes. Local API/OTLP receipt and upstream ingest acknowledgement are separate from a fresh trace in the intended cloud Agent Stream; ordinary APM receipt is not that proof.

Rule: Write compatible Markdown and separate self-contained human HTML reports. Audit refresh during selection is allowed; after selection, instrumentation rendering must preserve the canonical audit and selected scope. A missing audit fallback must retain selection.
Example: Ordinary cards appear directly under Findings; only AO cards are nested. Required items precede recommended items, with their detail hierarchy intact.
Evidence: Inspect audit/instrumentation bytes and both report views.
Insufficient evidence: Overwriting the audit during instrumentation rendering or losing selection, card grouping or priority order.

Rule: Run local otel-verify for available app-code scenarios even without remote credentials. Use bound reader-first reports: What Changed, Tested And Working, Not Working Or Not Proven, then Proof. Keep status Partial while selected proof is incomplete.
Example: Only when neither an otel-verify invocation nor its adjacent skill file is available, use selected scenario IDs and bundled validation/rendering scripts rather than marking every check Not run.
Evidence: Record exact local results and separate runtime/package blockers from remote-credential blockers.
Insufficient evidence: A clean-looking report that skips available app-code proof or claims complete verification despite missing evidence.

Rule: Provide .env.studio.example or a repository-native equivalent for Studio, using the real reachable port and supported SDK API/console/local-auth settings independently of native OTLP. Document selecting one exclusive profile and clearing inherited cross-mode variables. Consume resource names in the app. Remove active cloud realm/token conflicts; keep direct-cloud mode separately usable and preserve explicit destinations.
Example: If the gateway is unavailable, report that blocker and leave unresolved values inactive. For a temporary loopback SDK test, clear realm/token, use local API/console URLs and API key local-gateway, and intercept only health/login/current-user.
Evidence: Exercise the installed SDK through its actual /otel/v1/traces network delegate. Assert endpoint, local key/headers, local mode and resolved resources before export. Mark a temporary test as local proof, not a live profile.
Insufficient evidence: A placeholder active port/origin, fabricated IDs, a mode switch to hide failure, mocked export, or a direct-realm test offered as gateway proof.

Rule: Bind project_id and agent_stream_id before constructing installed splunk-ao 0.4.0 exporters/processors. Dispatch each span once to its configured stream; ordinary OTel processing must continue for every operation.
Example: A real SplunkAOOTLPExporter capture test covers two streams. A third configured lookup failure and an unknown route construct/export through neither an AO exporter nor a default route.
Evidence: Use the installed exporter and network delegate to inspect endpoint and headers, plus an ordinary in-memory processor. Use the resolved port configuration.
Insufficient evidence: Unscoped add_span_processor, late span attributes/context as routing, fake exporters, or mocked lookups alone.

Rule: With names only and no initial IDs, keep one launcher PID through initial API 503 and later connection. Continue local telemetry, then reuse existing resources automatically with zero creates and consistent native headers/Resource IDs or the SDK-owned equivalent.
Example: Enabling the API lets that already-running process bind without manual setup or restart.
Evidence: Inspect PID, resource journals, native telemetry and the binding/export boundary across recovery.
Insufficient evidence: Preseeded IDs, restart/manual/env-only recovery, or permanently stripping a valid cached binding after transient failure. Fresh cloud assembly remains a separate claim.
